notes.title: Quartet Out Now! Plus new RPG Release Dates!
notes.notes:
Huge news from the Infinite Alliance! 🚨
Quartet is Out Now!
Quartet by Something Classic is OUT NOW on Steam 🥳 I've been lucky enough to play a pre-release build of the game, and I truly think it's a must-play RPG that's well worth your time - especially if you love classic Final Fantasy.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1307960/Quartet/"][/dynamiclink]

Please support this amazing team of passionate developers! Plus, you'll get to learn all about Alexandra before her appearance in Infinite Alliance 😉


[previewyoutube="x1dtKybfyaE;full"][/previewyoutube]

Release Dates
Two other Infinite Alliance games have just announced release dates which are coming up fast!



Shrine's Legacy launches on the 7th of October on Steam! 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1435410/Shrines_Legacy/"][/dynamiclink]

Kingdoms of the Dump launches in November on Steam!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2159270/Kingdoms_of_the_Dump/"][/dynamiclink]Please wishlist these titles to support the developers ahead of launch 😊



So 2025 is absolutely stacked with great titles! I couldn't be more excited for all three games, so I really hope that you can show these amazing devs some love if their games appeal to you 🙏


Another great RPG coming soon
While not a part of Infinite Alliance, I did also want to mention that Jimmy and the Pulsating Mass is coming soon to all major consoles with new content, courtesy of Electric Airship - the same publisher which is supporting Infinite Allliance. 



There's no release date yet, but check out their mailing list to stay up-to-date:

https://airport.electricairship.com/jimmy/



Thanks for supporting all of our wonderful developers everyone!
~Josh
